title: Dataset of neurons and intracranial EEG from human amygdala during aversive dynamic visual stimulation
description: Electrophysiological dataset recorded from the amygdalae of nine epilepsy patients undergoing preoperative invasive monitoring in the mesial temporal lobe. Participants viewed dynamic visual sequences of fearful faces (aversive condition) interleaved with neutral landscapes (neutral condition). The dataset provides intracranial EEG in BIDS format, together with neuronal spike times and waveforms in NIX format, enabling study of amygdalar responses to aversive stimuli from macroscopic field potentials to single-neuron firing.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG and microwire neuronal activity were recorded from the amygdala in epilepsy patients during a task with dynamic fearful face videos and neutral landscape videos. BIDS metadata cover task, subjects, sessions and electrodes; spike times and waveforms are provided in NIX files.
